title: Who Decides How Knowing Becomes Doing? Redistributing Authority in Human–AI Music Co-Creation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how generative AI music systems homogenize non-mainstream and minority musical traditions (e.g., Cantonese opera styles, irregular rhythms) into Western/mainstream defaults (e.g., 4/4 time, C major). The study measures this through surveys, interaction logs, and interviews with 180 music practitioners interacting with baseline and experimental systems to assess the preservation of cultural plurality and minority aesthetics.
